pages.text: I found it. Or it let me find it. An altar of dark stone, surrounded by pillars, old and silent and waiting. The voice is loud now, louder than it has ever been. It says this is where the one with the black blade can be called. It says the pillars must burn first, each one fed with a heart full of souls, and then the eye must be given to the altar. I do not know how I know what the voice means. I just know. Standing here, I can feel something watching me, the way it has watched me all along, from the edges of the mist, from the corners of my eye. Tall, dark, cracks of cyan light running across its body like a map of rivers. The voice says this is the one who broke the Abyss. It says that when it falls, everything down here will finally be free. My hand is burning. I think it agrees.
